Build Strength, Not Strain

Good posture isn't only about sitting right. It's about having the strength to stay that way without thinking about it.

Today's 3 steps

Gently engage your core
Like zipping up a fitted pair of jeans. Relaxed, not rigid.
Strengthen your upper back
Shoulder-blade squeezes and chest openers counter long hours at a desk.
Build gradually
A few minutes a day beats one big session. Consistency over intensity.
